tips.text: Bring a radiation-damage sniper such as Rubico for the small Synovia; precision beats area damage here.
Use any Amp and start without waiting for a better one; a good Amp only shortens the shield phases.
Use Wukong's Cloud Walker or Titania to shorten the long approach to the arena.
Farm the Argon Crystal last, right before you build the Chassis; it decays every day.
Do not count on Xaku's Void damage to strip the shields; use your Operator.
Use mobility abilities freely during the fight; only the phase-one wires still nullify them.
Run it solo to dodge the host-migration bugs this fight is known for.
Call your Railjack crewmate to clear the adds while you focus on the boss.
Most players need 10 to 20 kills for all four blueprints, but a few see 40 or more without one part.
The Hexenon scrape, not the boss, is what wears players down.
